Infrared Sauna Connectors

Hello! Our main goal is to provide your best quality infrared sauna parts. Just complete the form and our specialist would contact you as soon as possible!

Some reasons to choose us!

  • How do you know if you can find the right company to supply all your infrared sauna parts?
  • And if you have one, does your supplier maintain the relationship with you to make sure all your needs are met?
  • Read on to find out more about a company that is not just a supplier, but also there to help you make your sauna business grow and thrive.

“I love getting my supply from InfraredSaunaParts because they’re helpful, professional, and friendly. And if there’s something they don’t have, they make sure they update the inventory and get back to their customers.”

Benny, Tallahessee, FL

At InfrareadSaunaParts, we make sure we have as many things as our clients need so we’re able to meet all their needs. We’re constantly updating our inventory to make sure we have everything our clients need. Our 30,000 sq. ft. facilty houses infrared sauna parts from accessories to carbon heaters to connectors to LED lights.

If you own an infrared sauna, then you know the importance of maintaining the equipment and quickly replacing the broken appliances to maintain the safety at your sauna. Our products are certified and comply with safety regulations to ensure that there are no accidents that could cause our clients trouble or misfortune.

We have many clients who prefer our brand of connectors for their infrared sauna appliances and we have a wide selection range of connectors to make sure our clients will able to find something that fits their needs. You can either purchase connectors in a set, but they’re also available as separate items.

Since you have many different types of sauna electrical devices, we carry male and female power cords of different fits. All of our connectors and cords are certified and they’re protected from overheat, liquids, and humidity.

Spend some time going through out online catalogue to find out about other items that we supply and if you happen to need something that we don’t have, why not give us a call at the number below and we’ll arrange to find it and supply it to you.
